Name: Sync Alerts
Author: Admin

Parameters.Description: The name of the environment from which to sync alerts.
Login API root of the Microsoft Defender XDR instance.
API root of the Microsoft Graph service.
API root of the Microsoft Defender XDR instance.
Microsoft Defender XDR account tenant ID.
Microsoft Defender XDR account client ID.
Microsoft Defender XDR account client secret.
The number of hours to synchronize alerts prior to the current time. The default value is `24`.
If enabled, job will sync assignee from Microsoft Defender XDR to Google SecOps.
If selected, the integration validates the SSL certificate when connecting to the Microsoft Defender XDR server. Enabled by default.

Description: This job synchronizes Google SecOps Alerts and Microsoft Defender XDR Alerts. It ensures that comments and status are synchronized bi-directionally between both systems. Note: Assignee synchronization occurs exclusively from Microsoft Defender to Google SecOps. For the job to identify the correct information, the Google SecOps case must have the "Microsoft Defender XDR Alert" tag. If the alert didn’t originate from "Microsoft 365 Defender - Incidents Connector",  you will need to add an "Alert_ID" context value to the alert for the job to be able to find the correct information.
